entry.title: Resolution 201 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Withdrawn
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS FOR AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAIʻI AT MĀNOA AND AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO SUCH AGREEMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a multi-year cost sharing agreement, with a term of five years, with the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa to share the cost of funding two additional Extension Agent positions in Hawaiʻi County to cover Indigenous Crops/East Hawaiʻi Master Gardeners and East Hawaiʻi Livestock.

Status: — → Withdrawn

Latest action: FC: Withdrawn - 6/3/2025
